title: trifolium lappaceum var. carteiense
intro: Trifolium lappaceum var. carteiense, commonly known as the 'Sicilian Clover', is a plant species within the legume family, Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium lappaceum var. carteiense include its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for managing various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
